**Truthammer — 3 October 2026**
**A guest checks out early**

The displacer beast that entered Dain’s tent runs away because Stinking Cloud smells so bad. Two missed attacks and one appalling atmosphere: Truthammer hospitality has made its impression.

Its destination and the wider battle outcome are still unreported. Dain remains last recorded at 28 HP; no concentration ending, new damage or extra resource use is reported.
